content_sections.heading: About North & Middle Andaman DCPU
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) works under the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, North & Middle Andaman District, at Mayabunder in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. These posts are in the district's Specialized Adoption Agency (SAA), which runs under the Mission Vatsalya Scheme. The vacancy notice is signed by the Assistant Commissioner (HQ), North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates may hand in the application directly or send it through surface mail to this address: The District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Office of the Deputy Commissioner, North & Middle Andaman District, Mayabunder-744204, Telephone: 03192-273127 Use the application form printed on the last page of the vacancy notice. The notice can be downloaded from www.andaman.gov.in and https://northmiddle.andaman.nic.in/ . Write the post applied for, name and father's/husband's name in block letters, date of birth, age as on 12/12/2026, sex, permanent and communication addresses with phone numbers, and the Employment Registration number. Fill in the education table (qualification, university/board, maximum marks, marks obtained, percentage) and the experience table (institution/company, designation and responsibilities, period worked in months). Paste a self-attested photograph in the box on the form, then sign the declaration with place and name. Attach the self-attested photocopies listed under Enclosures below. Put the application in a cover superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ..........", writing the name of the post. Deliver it by hand or by surface mail so that it reaches the office by 12 December 2026, 1.00 pm. Applications received after this date and time will not be accepted in any circumstances, even if received by post. Unsigned or incomplete applications, and applications without a photograph, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All four posts are purely on contractual basis. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the vacancies. Educational Qualification: B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognized University. Monthly Remuneration: Rs.11,916/-. Educational Qualification: MBBS from a recognized University. Monthly Remuneration: Rs.9,930/-. Educational Qualification: Must Passed the Secondary School Examination (Xth) standard from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience: 01 year of experience working as an Ayah/Female Attendant in a registered Hospital/Health Institution/Anganwadi worker/Helper. Monthly Remuneration: Rs.7,944/-. Educational Qualification: Must Passed the Secondary School Examination (Xth) standard from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience: 01 year of experience working as a Security Guard in Govt./Pvt. Monthly Remuneration: Rs.7,944/-. Age: the notice does not mention an age limit for any post. The application form asks candidates to state their age as on 12/12/2026. The notice does not mention allowances beyond the monthly remuneration. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of the following must be enclosed with the application: Mark Sheets Certificates in support of Education Qualification Diploma/Certificate in Computers Birth Certificate Local Certificate Employment Registration Card Experience Certificate(s), specifying the NATURE & PERIOD of experience – order copies are not considered as experience The form itself also needs a self-attested photograph and the candidate's signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will first be verified. After verification, a list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the notice board of the Deputy Commissioner's Office and the District Child Protection Unit, N&M Andaman, and on the websites www.andaman.gov.in and https://northmiddle.andaman.nic.in/ . Eligible candidates then appear for an interview. No individual call letter will be issued for the interview; candidates must check the displayed list. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. No accommodation will be provided for candidates appearing for the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in North & Middle Andaman DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 posts: Nurse 1, Doctor (Part Time) 1, Ayahs 6 and Chowkidar 1, in the Specialized Adoption Agency under Mission Vatsalya Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 12 December 2026, 1.00 pm; applications received after this will not be accepted in any circumstances.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Nurse and Doctor posts?
faq.answer: Nurse needs B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognized University, and Doctor (Part Time) needs MBBS from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Ayahs and Chowkidar?
faq.answer: Both need the Secondary School Examination (Xth) from a recognized Board/Institution. Ayahs also need 01 year of experience as an Ayah/Female Attendant in a registered Hospital/Health Institution/Anganwadi worker/Helper, and Chowkidar needs 01 year of experience as a Security Guard in Govt./Pvt.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.11,916/- for Nurse, Rs.9,930/- for Doctor (Part Time), and Rs.7,944/- each for Ayahs and Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the application form given in the notice and send it directly or through surface mail to The District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Office of the Deputy Commissioner, North & Middle Andaman District, Mayabunder-744204.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The cover must be superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ..........", with the name of the post filled in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: After verification of applications, a list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the notice boards and websites, and they will be called for an interview; no individual call letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contractual basis, likely to be extended on mutual consent, and gives no right to regular appointment or continuity of service.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid and no accommodation will be provided for candidates attending the interview.
